roles.name: Production planner
roles.description: Plans production orders, BOMs, routings, and material requirements.
responsibilities: Schedule work orders against work centers

provenance.notes: Reasoned from both platforms' planning-oriented models (Build.responsible/issued_by; mrp.production's planning fields).

roles.name: Shop floor operator
roles.description: Executes work orders at a work center, reporting progress and consuming materials.

provenance.notes: Reasoned from InvenTree's barcode mixin and BuildItem consumption model; single source.

roles.name: Quality inspector
roles.description: Performs and records quality tests, and dispositions non-conforming material.

roles.name: Purchasing agent
roles.description: Manages supplier relationships and places purchase orders for materials.

roles.name: Maintenance technician
roles.description: Services and repairs work center equipment.

provenance.notes: Reasoned from mrp.workcenter's working_state/blocked_time fields; no dedicated maintenance-role model found. Single source, reasoned.

roles.name: Plant / operations manager
roles.description: Oversees overall production performance, capacity, cost, and quality across the shop floor.
responsibilities: Monitor work center load and late orders

provenance.notes: Reasoned from mrp.workcenter's computed workorder_*_count fields, which serve a management-level view; single source.

roles.name: Supplier / vendor
roles.description: The external company fulfilling a purchase order or subcontracted operation.

provenance.notes: InvenTree's Company model (is_supplier flag); single source.

roles.name: System / MRP engine
roles.description: Automated actor that computes material shortages and updates work center status from scanned events.
responsibilities: Compute work order/work center state transitions

provenance.notes: Reasoned from mrp.workorder's compute='_compute_state' and stock.warehouse.orderpoint's automated reorder logic; single source.
